label: Locksmith
description: Locked out, broken or sticking locks, new keys or a lock change.

required_shots.hint: The lock or deadbolt, close enough to see its type and condition.

required_shots.tip: From the outside if you can.
required_shots.hint: The full door and frame the lock is on.

required_shots.prompt: Show the edge of the door
required_shots.tip: Where the bolt comes out, if the door is open.
required_shots.hint: The door's edge with the latch and bolt.

severity_guide: a spare key or a minor adjustment, nothing urgent
a sticky lock that still works
a lock change or rekey, or a lock that barely works
a broken lock on an outside door, or the home can't be secured

policy.finding_wording: Lock issue as shown, on-site locksmith visit recommended.
